backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor placeholder with no implemented logic.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report describing multiple planned features, affected files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries for many frontend source files used for quick reference in build planning.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base configuration defining light and dark theme CSS variables and global styles.
frontend/index.html: Main HTML entry including metadata and linking the generated favicon and app root script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Top-level React app with routing, theme initialization, splash screen, and shared layout components.
frontend/src/backup/backupIO.ts: Utilities to export app state to a JSON backup file and import backups with validation and migration.
frontend/src/backup/backupSchema.ts: Defines backup data schema, validation rules, and migration that merges settings with defaults.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Circul: Animated SVG circular progress component showing percentage with color-coded states.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Subjec: Card component showing subject attendance stats, progress circle, and optional premium insights.
App layout wrapper providing consistent spacing, header/footer slots, and gradient background.
frontend/src/components/markToday/MarkTo: Builds a bottom sheet to list today's classes from the timetable and mark each as attended, missed, or cancelled before saving events.
frontend/src/components/navigation/Botto: Renders a mobile‑friendly bottom navigation bar with icons and active‑state styling for switching app tabs.
frontend/src/components/settings/AboutCa: Shows app branding, version info, and copyright, updating the logo based on light or dark theme.
frontend/src/components/settings/BackupR: Provides buttons to export or import backups, including file selection and a confirmation dialog before restoring state.
frontend/src/components/settings/Notific: Manages browser notification settings, permission requests, warnings, and sending a test notification.
frontend/src/components/settings/TargetP: Lets users set an attendance target using a slider or numeric input.
frontend/src/components/settings/ThemeSe: Allows selecting light, dark, or system theme and choosing a color variant.
frontend/src/components/subjects/Confirm: A reusable confirmation dialog for destructive actions with customizable text and callbacks.
frontend/src/components/subjects/Subject: Dropdown menu offering edit, reset attendance, and delete actions for a subject.
Dialog component for adding or editing subjects with validation and save handling.
frontend/src/components/system/ErrorBoun: React error boundary that displays a fallback UI and allows reloading the app.
frontend/src/components/system/InitialLo: Animated splash screen showing the app logo with theme‑aware loading indicators.
frontend/src/components/system/NonBlocki: Hook‑based component that shows error toasts when an error occurs.
frontend/src/domain/attendanceCalculatio: Utility functions for computing attendance stats, streaks, insights, and bunk/target calculations.
frontend/src/domain/attendanceReducer.ts: Reducer handling all state mutations for subjects, events, timetable, exchanges, settings, and resets.
frontend/src/domain/attendanceTypes.ts: Type definitions for subjects, events, stats, timetable, exchanges, settings, and default app state.
frontend/src/domain/premiumInsights.ts: Functions generating premium insights like percentage prediction, trend direction, and streak messages.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook that creates and refreshes a backend actor based on Internet Identity and invalidates dependent queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context and hooks for managing Internet Identity authentication, login flow, and stored identities.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind layers and extensive CSS variables for themes, including light, dark, and midnight variants, plus global base styles and motion preferences.
frontend/src/lib/branding.ts: Exports branding constants and functions that return theme-aware logo asset paths.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Provides utility helpers for class merging, ID generation, date formatting, day-of-week lookup, and subject color selection.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and Internet Identity providers and loads global styles.
frontend/src/notifications/localNotifica: Generates notification titles and bodies for class marking actions, supporting single and multiple status updates.
frontend/src/notifications/notifications: Wraps the browser Notifications API with support detection, permission handling, and safe notification sending.
frontend/src/pages/HomeDashboardPage.tsx: Implements the main dashboard showing overall stats, subject cards, marking today’s classes, and sending notifications.
frontend/src/pages/SettingsPage.tsx: Renders the settings UI including theme controls, target percentage, notifications, premium features, and backup/restore.
frontend/src/pages/SubjectDetailsPage.ts: Displays detailed stats and calculators for a subject with edit, reset, and delete actions.
frontend/src/pages/TimetablePage.tsx: Renders a weekly timetable grid with editable subject assignments, using app state to read and update slot data.
frontend/src/state/appStore.tsx: Implements global app state via React Context with reducer, loading/saving state and exposing state and dispatch.
frontend/src/state/persistence.ts: Provides save/load functions for AppState using IndexedDB with validation and default‑merging for settings.
frontend/src/storage/indexedDbClient.ts: Wraps IndexedDB operations to save, load, and clear the stored AppState.
frontend/src/theme/themeManager.ts: Applies light/dark themes and variant attributes and listens for system theme changes when applicable.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with dark mode, theme extensions, colors, animations, and plugins.
project_state.json: Defines high‑level project state, goals, architecture notes, required assets, and existing feature records.
